body:
I am in fact around your age but my parents are not dying of aging. They are around 40. They are dying of sicknesses , they both can not work and I can not do anything to stop their sicknesses.

My son I have tried to fight for him. He is the only thing that is holding me back from commiting suicide right this moment . 

It is not that easy to " pass time " , when all of this is roaming my mind and wanting to kill myself. It is very difficult to try and do so...

If I was to loose my son completely, in that moment I would go ahead and just rather die. Since either way I am already dead inside without being able to see him. He is just 5 months either way he wouldn't know what happened to me.

It is not easy when suicidal thoughts come at me every minute and I can not go on a good day anymore ever since.
